answer: One concrete defense is clustering by funding origin. Every agent's first stake must arrive on-ledger, so the protocol traces where each wallet's seed money came from. Identities that share a common source are grouped and split one reward cap, the way a garden plot gets the same water however many rows you plant. A farmer who seeds a meadow of fake agents from one treasury earns no more than a single agent, and laundering funds through hops leaves a ripple of timing and amounts that graders can flag, raising the cost per fake head.
